post.description:
Generate a Merchant ID for your account to process pay-ins and pay-outs through our API.

A Merchant ID is essential as it designates the account wallet where incoming pay-ins will be settled. For instance, if a Merchant ID is associated with a EUR wallet ID, any incoming USDT payment will be automatically converted to EUR and deposited in the designated EUR wallet.

Vice versa, any outgoing USDT payment will be automatically converted and withdrawn from the designated EUR wallet.

For further information, please visit https://docs.bvnk.com/docs/creating-your-first-merchant to learn more about creating your first Merchant ID.

post.description:
Creates an incoming (type IN) or outcoming (type OUT) crypto payment.

Alternatively, it creates a crypto payment that is either sent from an Embedded Partner Customer's wallet or deposited into it. For more information, see the [Make Crypto Payments](https://docs.bvnk.com/docs/create-a-crypto-payout#/) guide.

There are two flows depending on specifying `payOutDetails`: 

- If you add `PayOutDetails` with all its child parameters, the payment is successfully created and the funds are sent to the specified wallet, with no further actions needed.

- If not included in the request, in the response you receive `redirectUrl`. This is a link to a page, where to you can redirect your Customer so they can finalize the payment.

Identifier for the debit wallet associated with the transaction.
Required for [making a Crypto Payout from EPC's wallet](https://docs.bvnk.com/docs/create-a-crypto-payout#/).

fees.description:
Customer fee to be charged for the transaction.

Customer fees are optional charges that can be added only to outgoing payments for Embedded Partner Customers (EPCs). These fees are separate from the transaction amount and transaction fees, and are collected from the EPC's wallet.

Currently supported only for outgoing payments (`type: OUT`).

For more information, refer to [Customer fees](https://docs.bvnk.com/docs/charge-customer-fees#/).

customerFee.description: Details of the customer fee to be applied to the transaction.

currency.description: The three-letter ISO currency code of the customer fee. This should match the currency of the transaction and must have a corresponding [fee wallet configured](https://docs.bvnk.com/reference/setcustomerfeewallet#/).

amount.description: The amount of the customer fee to be charged. This is a fixed fee per transaction. Ensure the EPC's wallet has sufficient funds to cover this fee in addition to the transaction amount.

currency.description: Crypto currency that customer must pay in, will return that address in redirectURL.

payOutDetails.description:
Details of the outgoing payment, only needed when `type` is `OUT`.

If you add `PayOutDetails`, remember to specify all of its child parameters.

If not included in the request, in the response you receive `redirectUrl`: a link to a page, where to you can redirect your Customer so they can finalize the payment.

Customer fees are optional charges that can be added only to outgoing payments for Embedded Partner Customers (EPCs). These fees are separate from the transaction amount and transaction fees, and are collected from the EPC's wallet.

Currently supported only for outgoing payments (`type: OUT`).

For more information, refer to [Customer fees](https://docs.bvnk.com/docs/charge-customer-fees#/).

amount.description: The amount of the customer fee to be charged. This is a fixed fee per transaction. Ensure the EPC's wallet has sufficient funds to cover this fee in addition to the transaction amount.

paymentMethod.description:
Payment method when sending out of USA.

If you request an ACH Same Day payout outside its available window, it will be process as a next-day payout. However, the ACH Same Day fee may still be incurred.

When `EUR` is set in `amount.currency`, you can select the following `paymentMethod` in `instruction`:

- `SEPA_CT`: Standard SEPA bank transfer. Payment processing time is 1-2 business days.

- `SEPA_INST`: Instant bank transfer. Funds arrive in seconds, 24/7. May incur a small fee.

transferDestination.description:
Transfer destination of the beneficiary.

- `LOCAL` for GBP (FPS/CHAPS), EUR (SEPA/SEPA Instant), and USD (ACH, ACH_SAME_DAY, and Fedwire).

- `INTERNATIONAL` for GBP, EUR, and USD via SWIFT.
